failure_modes: Time-conditioned teacher/attention edit (C008-C011) displaces surrounding coordinates without demonstrated affinity gain, since the contrast functions are weakly identified with sign conflicts and are not validated affinity predictors.
Larger pointcloud_delta_A dose (C002/C003) increases unnecessary coordinate displacement and strain/clash risk while the primary affinity objective cannot be evaluated from supplied evidence.
Interpreting the temporal contrast derivative as a spatial gradient force would misapply the registered temporal recipe, which changes only regional attention at observed score nodes, not velocity.
Relying on last-record survival or geometric teacher-proximity enrichment as affinity benefit would be survivor-biased and is explicitly not terminal affinity evidence.
rationale: D1.2: The permitted time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009-C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change teacher coordinates/regional attention at observed score nodes, not merely dose; the stationary incumbent uses static teachers with time_ramp_power 0.0. The temporal evidence is only weakly identified: continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed, polynomial fits rejected, and the inspected landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts with relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78, so a time-conditioned rule is not defensibly better than the stationary coordinate target. D4.1: Compared with the incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, teacher_neighbors 4, static teachers), the offered edits are either dose scalars (C001-C003 pointcloud_delta_A) or attention/teacher changes (C004-C011). No evidence provides a defensible expected affinity advantage: the objective is final predicted affinity primary, recorded affinities are removed with an equal-score prior, and the audit states the geometric teacher-proximity metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and not a validated affinity predictor. D4.2: The predicted failure of a time-conditioned or larger-dose edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates (excess fixed RMS already ~0.081 A) and increased strain/clash risk without demonstrated affinity gain, since last-record survival credit is not final affinity benefit and ancestral coverage is sparse. Following affinity-first priority, retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; a temporal derivative is not treated as a spatial gradient and no temperature edit is proposed.
